frequency_question: How often do intended policy actions by this central bank successfully meet the exact formal announcement criteria without being preempted, withdrawn, or technically failing definitions?
membership_rule: Includes all formal board-level decisions on capital buffers or structural lending rates; excludes informal speeches, staff working papers, and tentative proposals that never reach a binding vote.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: Targeted specifically to Federal Reserve capital buffer governance actions.
known_gaps: Limited direct history of active CCyB adjustments above 0% in the US, requiring reliance on general regulatory board vote-to-announcement fidelity.
skeleton: Formal regulatory proposals reaching board vote vs. successfully promulgated final press releases.
multiplier: 3 successful formal announcements / 3 formal board considerations of the specific buffer framework
validity_reason: Central bank voting and official release procedures change slowly over multi-year horizons.
